items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 May 2026 7:31am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 02 May 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic as various weak fronts and troughs affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the west, becoming variable 3 or less later in the evening, becoming north or northeast 2 to 4 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair with a risk of areas of mist and isolated fog patches. Isolated showers in the west, then rain later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain, showers or mist. Very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northeast 2 to 4, becoming variable 3 or less overnight into Monday.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Occasional outbreaks of rain, soon becoming isolated.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in rain.
